facts.meaning: The tenure-local commitment tracker records a monotonically increasing index reached by a majority of the current voter match indexes and at least its startIndex.
facts.validity_context: One leader tenure; current voter set. This is an internal support accounting assertion, not independently verified storage durability or completed FSM application.
facts.durability: Volatile tracker; entries reside in caller-provided LogStore.
facts.recovery: New leader creates a fresh tracker; restart reconstructs log and snapshot positions.

facts.meaning: Cached log and snapshot index/term pairs used to represent this instance latest retained history position; updates occur on successful append, restart or snapshot paths. Failed append after truncation can leave older cache values.
facts.validity_context: Accessor locks provide coherent pairs, not proof that cached log is still present after storage failure; user restore intentionally synthesizes a log boundary backed by snapshot.
facts.durability: Volatile metadata referring to caller stores.
facts.recovery: NewRaft rebuilds from actual store and snapshot; remote install changes snapshot boundary.

facts.meaning: A verifyFuture starts with one self vote and increments for positive callbacks from registered replication workers; its completion threshold is derived from voter count. The tally itself carries no voter identities.
facts.validity_context: Pending verification; peer notification maps detach callbacks and voteLock/notifyCh limit completion notification. Callback suffrage eligibility has not been established.
facts.recovery: New request and leader tenure establish new registration; leader exit responds leadership loss.

surfaces.entry_point: Raft.appendEntries: truncation followed by StoreLogs failure
surfaces.reason: Concrete cache/storage discrepancy acknowledged in source; subsequent retry may encounter deleted indexes because cached lastLogIdx remains old. Fault applicability and recovery alternatives unresolved.
Snapshot installation and user restoration traced; boundary variants remain open.
Vote term and candidate persist separately; investigate prior candidate plus failed candidate write before alleging duplicate-vote failure.
Voter-derived threshold with registration over all replication peers is selected for investigation.

formation.explanation: Leader persists assigned term/index entries then records its match. Per-peer workers accept successful append/snapshot responses into a tenure-specific voter tracker; newer terms signal loss of authority. Majority index must reach the current-term startIndex. Main loop consumes commit notification, advances configuration and queues ordered command/barrier tuples to one FSM worker; successful application futures complete after Apply/ApplyBatch. Followers validate previous term, reconcile/store suffix and consume propagated leader commit. Periodic ordinary replication propagates commitment; empty fast-path heartbeats do not. Failed pipeline returns to ordinary retries, whose missing leader logs cause snapshot fallback.

context.explanation: Heartbeat expiry permits configured voters to campaign. Pre-vote does not advance term; actual election persists term and self-vote, asks each other latest voter once and tallies a per-campaign channel. Vote handlers reject ineligible candidates and stale histories, and persist a new vote before granting. Newer terms, voter lease loss or removal cause authority loss; tenure exit resolves pending leader futures and stops workers. Transfer waits for selected replication catch-up then TimeoutNow triggers a privileged election. Snapshot installation and restart reconstruct history/configuration; explicit user restore aborts pending writes and creates a new snapshot-backed boundary.

connection.explanation: Voting log freshness links future authority to retained history; new tenure commitment starts empty and requires a current-term entry before inherited prefix can commit. Old replication workers retain old tracker and stepDown channels; old election replies retain old campaign channels. Latest voter membership controls election and commitment, changes are gated by prior configuration/current-term commitment, and suffix truncation can revert pending membership. Snapshot metadata records committed membership and restore/restart rebuild context. Client leader loss is uncertain completion, distinct from completed FSM application. Verification is another authority consumer: its voter-count threshold is fed by all registered peer callbacks, an unresolved eligibility discrepancy.

Split vote persistence failure history and old snapshot boundary behavior remain sourced open surfaces.
Transport pipeline error correspondence and deeper transfer overlap paths remain unread.
